title: FLOW unleashes 'Naruto' anthems in sold-out Manila concert
summary: Filipino concertgoers were transported to the Shinobi World as Japanese rock band FLOW performed iconic hits from the wildly popular anime series 'Naruto' at the SM North EDSA Skydome.
